title: card_rule.set@1
description: You set a card rule, on the card or from deep inbox (#69): purchases from one seller, up to a named amount, are paid by the payment processor with a card it holds, named by its reference. DeepBuild never holds a card number. The event's ID is the rule's. Only the core appends it, and only from the trusted path.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

seller.description: The seller the rule pays, by host.

max_usd.description: The most one purchase the rule pays may cost, in US dollars.

card.description: The payment processor's reference to the card it holds, never a card number.

via.description: Where you set it: the question card or deep inbox.

x-closure.closed: each value is a state the record defines and every reader acts on, so a value outside the list has no meaning
